propositions: Completion verification chronically fails without a verdict due to runaway duplicate tool-call loops, request-budget exhaustion, and recovery context bounds that reject valid ticket shapes like c9f7 (121,147 chars).
The verifier's recovery path isolates one LLM run per criterion, generating up to 440 requests worst-case with ~2.67M reintroduced context characters.
Duplicate read-only tool calls within a single agentic run are re-executed rather than memoized, causing observable waste (144x repeated search_files calls in live runs).
Recovery preflight enforces a flat 100,000-char context bound that is exceeded by live tickets and cannot adapt to the resolved model's window size or economic spend ceiling.
Verified per-criterion progress is not banked incrementally, so a run with partial success dies verdict-less on typed failure instead of finalizing to a full-coverage verdict.
